WHOLE_ACCOUNT_FROZEN.text: Your whole account is frozen over one payment. The rules say hold only the amount in dispute.

HOLD_MORE_THAN_DISPUTED.text: The bank is holding more than the disputed amount.

NO_AMOUNT_GIVEN.text: The notice does not say how much is held.

MISSING_DETAILS.text: The notice does not name the officer, complaint number or police station.

HOLD_TOO_LONG.text: The hold has gone past the 90-day limit.

FUTURE_CREDIT_HOLD_NOT_FIRST_LAYER.text: New money coming in is being held, but the rules allow that only for the first account in the money trail.

DIGITAL_BANKING_SUSPENDED.text: Your digital banking is blocked. There is a separate appeal route for that.

MONEY_ALREADY_MOVED.text: The disputed money had already left the account before the freeze.
